fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential processes activity of Ultra VNC RMM tool
fields.name: Potential Ultra VNC RMM Tool Process Activity
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((src.process.image.path contains "UVNC_Launch.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "winvnc.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "vncviewer.exe") or (tgt.process.image.path contains "UVNC_Launch.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "winvnc.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "vncviewer.exe")))
